meaning: Software that scans a device for harmful programs and removes them. It can also warn you before you open a bad file.
clues: It looks at the files on a device and checks whether each one is safe.
It is a program that runs quietly while you use your device.
It can find harmful programs and remove them.
Its job is to protect your device from computer viruses.
It has nine letters and starts with A. Its name says it is against viruses.
assumes: Malware is software made to cause harm
A backup is a spare copy of your files

decoys.meaning: Software made to harm a device, spy on its owner, or steal information.
A spare copy of your files, kept in a second place in case the first copy is lost.
A way to open a phone by looking at it. The phone checks that your face matches the one it saved.

exchange.text: Back in my day, viruses traveled on floppy disks, and I got checked a lot. I felt very popular.

exchange.text: Today, many computers already have one built in, like Windows Security on a Windows computer. Keep it turned on and let it update.
